ios.build: set -euo pipefail; root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; export CARGO_BUILD_JOBS="${CARGO_BUILD_JOBS:-4}" CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_BUILD_OVERRIDE_STRIP=none LANG=en_US.UTF-8; cargo build --release --manifest-path "$root/Cargo.toml" -p leptoskit_cli --bin leptoskit; "$root/target/release/leptoskit" native build ios-simulator --release

absent.windows: the arena's native plugin (launch scenario, frame clock, report, echo) is written for Apple and Android only; leptoskit's Windows app runs plugins in Rust and the arena has no Rust implementation of it yet
absent.linux: the arena's native plugin (launch scenario, frame clock, report, echo) is written for Apple and Android only; leptoskit's Linux app runs plugins in Rust and the arena has no Rust implementation of it yet

unsupported.autoscroll: the framework carries a scroll command and reports scroll events, but the arena's feed reports a zero-height container on Android, so its offsets never leave zero
unsupported.busy: an animated scroll runs on the platform, but the guest renders and blocks on the UI thread, so the animation cannot advance while app logic blocks
